# All datasets on disk: integration status (2026-09-29)

**Inventory.** There are 16 dataset folders under `data set/` and `data set for comparison/`. Image counts, folder structure and file types are in `all_datasets_manifest.json`, generated by `scripts/eval/scan_project.py`. Content and role per dataset are in the table in `SCAN_COMPLETE.md`.

## Bangladeshi Taka datasets

| Dataset | Labels | Integrated as | Result file |
|---|---|---|---|
| BanglaTaka raw (5,073) | denomination | detector training source (composites) | `data set/currency_yolo_data` |
| Synthetic composites (22,333) | denomination + box | detector train/val/test | `results/training_v2/test_eval/test_metrics.json` |
| New composites (566) | denomination + box | fresh detector test | `results/new_test/detector_newtest.json` |
| yolo_bbox_annotated (5,082) | tight boxes | box-quality evaluation | `results/bbox/` |
| JaalTaka (8,340 = 1,390 × 6) | genuine / counterfeit | authentication, note-disjoint | `results/qduig/`, `results/same_arch/` |
| Counterfeit-currency dataset (1,286) | genuine / counterfeit, 500 and 1000 | detector test + deployed-verdict test | `results/external/detector_counterfeit_ds.json`, `results/jaal_deployed/` |
| Bangla Money (1,536 + 101 one-taka) | denomination | detector test, open-set test, verdict test (genuine) | `results/external/`, `results/open_set/` |
| NSTU-BDTAKA (Detection + Recognition) | box / denomination | detector test; Recognition/validation as open-set validation | `results/external/`, `results/open_set/` |
| Large Scale BDT DB (coins, demonetized notes) | coin / demonetized | open-set validation unknowns | `results/open_set/` |
| "A Diverse Image Dataset …" | denomination | **excluded**: byte-identical to BanglaTaka raw | `CROSS_DATASET_TAKA.md` |

### Not integrated as authentication training data

**Counterfeit-currency dataset:** only 87 counterfeit images, and 32 of them are augmented copies. Whole-note photos cannot be grouped by physical note. Training on it and testing on it would leak between augmented copies of the same note.

The Bangla Money, NSTU and Large Scale sets **have no genuine/counterfeit labels**, so they cannot train or test authentication.

## Multi-view datasets

| Dataset | Integrated as | Result |
|---|---|---|
| JaalTaka | same-architecture fixed-view vs prefix test | `SAME_ARCH_RESULTS.md` |
| ModelNet40 (point clouds → 6 rendered views, 10 classes) | fixed-view vs prefix, 3 seeds | `VCDS_UNIVERSAL.md` |

No other multi-view dataset is on disk.

## Non-currency datasets

- **COCO:** composite backgrounds (val2017 for training, train2017 for the new test) and the object-mode evaluation.
- **RAF-DB, CK+48, facial_expressions:** emotion.
- **Ekush / MatriVasha:** handwritten Bangla letters.

## Scope

Foreign-currency datasets: none on disk, and none were added.

## Format conversions

None were needed:
- NSTU detection labels are already in YOLO format.
- Classification sets are class-folder trees.
- ModelNet is rendered in `train_modelnet_vcds.py`.
